SUPERVISOR: keyboard-bindings slice verified at my level — diffstat clean (660+/102-), verify GREEN 69/69 confirmed independently. It is user-facing, so it goes on the board for the user's hands before commit. Do NOT commit yet; leave the work in the tree.

Move to the top of your queue: ITEMSGONE — pre-existing game items (made earlier, undersized) do NOT appear in the new workbench ITEMS roster (it shows empty, only New/Import Voxels). This is the legacy-data-invisible-to-new-store-path family. Print where the old items actually live vs what itemsStream reads, then make legacy items visible the same way the world-pool fix did. NO silent migration.

After that, in order: clear-map resurrection fix (restore path must consume the same owner-map scope filter as fresh mount), then TWIGRESTORE with camera persistence FIRST — the user's camera resets every edit and it's actively hurting.
